title: Val Dillon was lord mayor
html_source: Yes, he was mayor in 1894. His term was 1894-1895. [Gifford]

anchor.prefix: in Lombard street west. Wait: was in Thom's. Got the job in Wisdom Hely's year we married. Six years. Ten years ago: ninetyfour he died yes that's right the big fire at Arnott's.
anchor.suffix: . The Glencree dinner. Alderman Robert O'Reilly emptying the port into his soup before the flag fell. Bobbob lapping it for the inner alderman. Couldn't hear what the band played.
